definitions: In or to a higher place or position, often implying a significant distance or elevation.
In a prominent or important position, often referring to a high rank or status.
In a distant or remote place, often implying a sense of being far away or out of reach.
In the sky or heavens, often referring to celestial bodies or a spiritual realm.
examples: He's one of the best players up there.
The cabin is way up there in the mountains.
Look at the stars up there tonight.
